**Ruling**: unblocked by the #4425 phase-2 ruling (whitelist promoted to the SDUI widget contract — see the ruling comment there, veto window open). This card is migration step 1 and carries the shared infrastructure: (1) measure `toDomProps`'s dependency-direction home per the #4409 method (expected: lift to `@object-ui/core`, `packages/fields` re-exports unchanged); (2) convert both `chatbot` and `chatbot-enhanced` registrations to consume-or-whitelist — the triage-flagged pair must be explicitly pinned: `datasource` (injected adapter — consumed, never stringified onto DOM) and the camelCase `arialabel`/`ariadescribedby` (must not appear; the resolved `aria-label`/`aria-describedby` must remain); (3) delete BOTH ledger rows in `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` in the same PR — the two-way ratchet makes the fix red until the rows go, which IS the red-first. `chatbot-floating` untouched (measured clean).

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`; if the helper lift adds a core export, minor `@object-ui/core` per emitted-`.d.ts` measurement; fields re-export graded by its own `.d.ts` diff.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/plugin-chatbot/**`, `packages/core` (helper lift only), `packages/fields` (re-export only), `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` (row deletion only), changesets. #4432 gates on this PR (shared ledger file + helper home).
